This is the classic Raft Log Matching Property. The implementation obligation is that when a follower appends entries from a leader after an AppendEntries check, it must not overwrite conflicting entries without first truncating; and the leader's log must be consistent such that same index/term implies same entry (no divergent entry creation at same index/term). So the crucial question is about the two logs having entries at the same (i, term) — do all earlier positions match?

This is the Raft "Log Matching Property". A well-known point where this is preserved in Raft is that entries with same index+term are equal because they were generated by the same leader for that term, and since a leader never overwrites entries in its own log, the follower copies from the leader's log, so they're identical; also earlier logs were identical at the time the leader took over (because leaders only become leader with log at least as up-to-date... wait that's not quite it either).
